author: GDevelop community
name: SecretMarks3D
shortDescription: Luminous marks and runes painted on a Terrain3D terrain, hidden in the dark and revealed only where Light3D lights really light the ground.
description: Paint luminous secret marks on a Terrain3D terrain.

The marks are stored in a texture in the terrain UV space and added to the terrain material emission. They are exactly invisible outside the light that actually reaches the ground (Light3D spot cones, penumbra, point light ranges and shadows). A mark only glows when Light3D really lights the terrain under it; away from every light it only shows very fast, very faint pulses.
- Free painting with dabs and strokes.
- 12 procedural ancient runes with a soft aura.
- Runes can be discovered and counted.
- Reveal based on the real light received by the ground, not a rough cone distance: the mark follows the visible pool of spot and point lights.
- Fast faint strobe when the mark is in the dark (can be disabled).
- No extra mesh and no z-fighting: the marks follow hills, holes and sculpted terrain.

propertyDescriptors.label: Ink color
propertyDescriptors.description: Color of the next painted strokes and stamped runes. Use the SetInkColor action to change it at runtime.
propertyDescriptors.name: InkColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Glow strength
propertyDescriptors.description: Emissive strength of the marks when they are lit.
propertyDescriptors.name: Strength

propertyDescriptors.label: Pulse speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Speed of the faint pulse of the lit marks.
propertyDescriptors.name: PulseSpeed

propertyDescriptors.label: Pulse depth
propertyDescriptors.description: Amplitude of the pulse of the lit marks, from 0 (no pulse) to 1 (strong pulse).
propertyDescriptors.name: PulseDepth

propertyDescriptors.label: Dark pulse
propertyDescriptors.description: Brightness of the very fast, faint strobe of the marks that are away from any light. Set it to 0 to keep the marks completely invisible in the dark.
propertyDescriptors.name: HiddenPulse

propertyDescriptors.label: Light reveal threshold
propertyDescriptors.description: Minimum brightness the ground must receive before the marks appear. Raise it to keep the marks only in the brightest part of a light; lower it to reveal them in dimmer light.
propertyDescriptors.name: RevealThreshold

propertyDescriptors.label: Mark map resolution
propertyDescriptors.description: Resolution of the canvas holding the marks. Higher values give sharper marks but use more memory.
propertyDescriptors.name: Resolution

propertyDescriptors.label: Default brush width
propertyDescriptors.description: Width of the brush used when the paint actions are given a width of 0.
propertyDescriptors.name: DefaultBrushWidth
